purpose: Public product-label and GI-study link map for five Finnish-classics drafts; do not treat public listing as physical pack or complete GI/macro review.
selectionRules: Use EAN and full product name including variant; never infer from brand alone.
Physical package, batch, edible/drained mass and cooking needed for full nutrition evidence.
Only the researched De Cecco n°12 GI is linked to a same-named product; still needs preparation and time-era review.
Other product GI matches remain unresolved. A pasta-category mean, lentil-group mean or rye-bread analog is forbidden.
Where retailer CHO figures conflict, record both and do not publish numeric macros until reconciled.
